observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same blue industrial machine from slightly different angles.
The machine has a large blue cylindrical hopper on top, likely for feeding material.
Below the hopper is a transparent section, possibly a feed tube or chamber.
The main body is blue metal with a horizontal metal bed or table with grooves, resembling a milling or cutting table.
There are black handwheels and knobs for manual adjustment, including one large black knob at the front.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area, surrounded by plastic sheeting and cardboard boxes.
